opening.argument: The speaker presents OneCoin as an investment opportunity built around paid packages and token allocations, stating that “the starter package cost 140 euros” and promising “with 4 000 tokens after splits.” The offer also includes recruitment and sales-based earnings: viewers are told they “can also send your downline as well,” while the slide identifies income from volume, direct sales, and matching bonuses. The presentation connects account participation with calculated euro appreciation and a 45-day split period, while making withdrawals conditional on identity, address, or financial information, including “you have to input your bank details.” These features establish a token-purchase and appreciation scheme, although the available evidence does not establish completed payments, payouts, document handling, or realized returns.
